mvp_relevance: Builds the paper execution ledger assembler service that converts a validated RiskDecisionRecord into a frozen PaperExecutionLedgerEntry under the mirror taxonomy fixed by 2H.A. This is the second of three Phase 2H sub-phases needed to satisfy REQ_0017 milestone 4 PAPER_EXECUTION_LEDGER_MVP and is the consumable derivation surface for Phase 2H.C (composition root) and REQ_0017 milestone 5 REPLAY_BACKTEST_RUNNER_MVP.
legacy_failure_addressed: missing typed mirror invariant between risk-side allow/deny verdicts and paper-side record_allow/record_deny entries in the legacy bot, where paper-mirror outcomes were stored as untyped log emissions side-by-side with live emissions and could silently diverge from the upstream risk decision. 2H.B closes this by mapping every value of the 2G.A _ALLOWED_RISK_REASONS frozenset (5 members) exhaustively onto the corresponding PAPER_LEDGER_REASON_MIRROR_* value, with a defensive fallback that raises PaperExecutionLedgerServiceError for any unrecognized input, and by propagating the input lineage fields (risk_decision_id, decision_id, prediction_id, feature_snapshot_id, symbol) unchanged into the typed PaperExecutionLedgerEntry. The 2H.A cross-field invariants (record_allow ↔ mirror_allow_*, record_deny ↔ mirror_deny_*, one-to-one mapping between ledger_reason_code and input_risk_reason_code, one-to-one mapping between ledger_action and input_risk_action) are satisfied by the derivation table by construction, so any 2H.B-produced entry passes the 2H.A __post_init__ gauntlet. The reserved 2G.A deny_default branch is supported by emitting mirror_deny_default and is verified by regression test never to be silently dropped.
